newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's SFC reprimands Salomon Brothers.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's SFC reprimands Salomon Brothers.

text.p: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) said on Friday it had reprimanded Salomon Brothers Hong Kong Ltd, a unit of Salomon Brothers Inc.
The SFC said in a statement that the reprimand related to the operation of the private investment department of Salomon Brothers during April 1993 to March 1994.
An SFC spokesman told Reuters no other action would be taken.
During an investigation, the SFC found that persons within the private investment department were not promptly registered with the commission when undertaking their duties, the statement said.

It also said certain staff, when marketing collateralised mortgage obligations to clients, did not fully understand the nature of the product, resulting in some clients buying the products without being fully informed of the risks involved.
